summary:
Not accepted. The worktree is clean and HEAD 23ddfe9 equals origin/task/T2a. The diff from e7e9114 adds 20 files: no renames and no shared files. Every reported number reproduces. Suite: 25 passed, 6 failed, 1 skipped, 599.7 s. The six failures are all in tests/standin_kit; they pass 6/6 at e7e9114 and fail only because the real F1-F4 in src now win over the stand-ins (spec issue 1).

What holds, checked independently:
- I evaluated 12000 random points per set on the C1 inner sets with the Python deck evaluator; t_local is 0.0762016..0.0769590 at t = 76.2 mm and 0.0254032..0.0256493 at t = 25.4 mm, all inside the M2 band.
- d_close on C1 is 0.1.
- The cylinder set equals its closed form bitwise, and the box set equals sti_inner_box.
- The stepped_spar inner volume differs from its closed form by -3.55e-15 m3.
- My own capsule test passes in full.

What fails:
1. outer_nurbs crashes with an index error at line 1203 on any deck where no patch converts exactly (a tilted-axis revolution, a decimal-coordinate fillet), so it never reaches fit_z_faces.
2. Arc conversion rejects ordinary decimal arcs: |ve| - r = 2.22e-16 against a bound of 16*eps(r) = 1.11e-16.
3. On an exact deck whose rounded rim folds (fillet radius 0.0625 < d = 0.076327), F2 trims the fold correctly (dense t_local = d) but returns report.ok = false without raising. M3 fails on non-monotone row heights and an open seam: 0.92367300000000019 against 0.92367299999999997.
4. F1 marks the wrong patches on a top T-junction deck: walls go to the general path and the constant-z tops stay exact (contract F1 rule order 1a/1b).
5. The general-path hand-off to T2b is incomplete: no fan or vertex entries with offset_of, mirrors of general primaries are dropped, and only the first piece is passed.
6. Several rounding bounds that decide topology have no derivation: 16, 64 and 256 ulp.
7. M3 sections are judged at no more than 40 heights.
verified: git -C /home/user/wt/T2a status clean; HEAD = origin/task/T2a = 23ddfe9; merge base e7e9114; diff --name-status: 20 files, all A (no R), all in the T2a file list (9 +solid files, 3 fixtures, 7 tests, helper inner_set_checks.m); no shared file of contract section 4 touched
Full suite rerun (octave --no-gui --quiet tests/run_tests.m, MWEC_REGRESSION unset): 25 passed, 6 failed (tests/standin_kit/*), 1 skipped, 599.7 s; identical to the report

Base e7e9114 (git archive to scratch), TESTS_FILTER=standin_kit: 6 passed, 0 failed; on T2a they fail with 'geo.analytic is empty', 'S1b fields', 'NotAnalytic not raised' and 'matrix cannot be indexed with .': the real src functions shadow the stand-ins
C1 F2b: d_close 0.10000000000000001 over the hull and 0.13492098838547734 over [-3.25, -0.7]; VoidClosed at t = 0.099873; smallest convex principal radius 0.0999999976 m printed

C1 t = 0.0762, full hull: 8 inner patches (no fold piece); surface1_inner1 has 33 u-knots, 4 passes and 19 knots removed; dense grid 0.0762142..0.0769588 against band [0.0762, 0.076962]; 79 sections and 24 seams pass M3. Precast range [-3.25, -0.7]: inner set reaches z = -0.6447, dense grid 0.0762797..0.0769515

Independent check by the grader: 12000 random (u, v) points per set on the C1 inner sets, with t_local computed in Python from tests/reference/c1_reference.py (C1 hull = {dist_xy(p, segment (0,+-1)) <= r(z)}, so the 3-D distance is the 2-D distance to curve6). Result: t = 0.0762 gives 0.0762015760..0.0769590097, t = 0.0254 gives 0.0254031682..0.0256492930; 0 points outside [t, t + 0.01 t] in either set

C1 Python half-widths: largest |difference| 1.71e-4 m (eps_fit/2 = 3.81e-4); module 4 void 3.542158 m3 against v1.0 3.548 m3 (printed only); MS2Parser points moved by d along -surface_normals lie within 3.78e-4 m of the inner set
C1 t = 0.0254: dense grid 0.0254057..0.0256486; neck inner half-width 0.0743958..0.0745204 against 0.1 - d = 0.074473; smallest inner/outer section area ratio 0.6028; M3 passes
knots_from: the refit at the same t reproduces every face bitwise; inner area at z = -2 has second differences 2.82e-7 against first differences -2.715e-3

Cylinder at t = 0.0254 and 0.0762: equals the closed form bitwise; dense t_local exactly d; second call served from the cache in 0.001 s; partial range reaches up to 0.025527; d_close 1.4999999999999998. Box: equals sti_inner_box (max difference 0 m); d_close 0.75

stepped_spar: rim trimmed at r = 1.4744729999999999 = 1.5 - d; largest fan-face deviation 3.64e-16 m; section at z = -1 - d/2 matches the closed form 0.72789296951759463; inner volume 16.609828832322165 against 16.609828832322169 (I re-derived the closed form pi(1.5-d)^2(2-2d) + pi(a^2 d - a pi d^2/2 + 2d^3/3) + pi(a-d)^2(2-d), a = 0.75); d_close 0.74999999999999989
trim_fold unit test: crossing 0.11313708498984761 against the closed form 0.11313708498984762

F1: C1 has 8 exact entries; 24 seams mutual and bitwise; I9 worst ratio 0.593 (5.48e-8 m at z = -1); outer_nurbs(model) equals outer_nurbs(model, cache, opts). split_wall_box: the three walls are split at z = -1, rows shared bitwise, 40 seams. box_swapped: swapped faces, F4 at z = -1 bitwise equal to box.ms2. Deck-check errors raised as specified
grep of the changed files for sqrt(.*pi), pi*r, compute_rmin, R_eq, cos_alpha, L_k, max_slope, homothetic and the old names: no hits
Accepted deviation, measured: F2 offsets the exact F1 NURBS instead of evaluating MS2Parser and surface_normals at each node; agreement 3.78e-4 m <= eps_fit/2 = 3.81e-4
violations: AGENTS section 1 rule 5 and contract section 8 (no underived merging bounds): rounding bounds without derivation or owner approval decide topology. 16 ulp: offset_surface.m:401 (crease or smooth joint), :1056 (planarity), :1158 (smooth seam), outer_nurbs.m:549 (arc end radius). 64 ulp: outer_nurbs.m:1240 (corner identification), :1416 (vertex inside a row). 256 ulp: outer_nurbs.m:1451 (curve coincidence). The arc bound is wrong in scale as well: a valid decimal arc gives |ve| - r = 2.22e-16 against the bound 1.11e-16 and is rejected

AGENTS section 5 items 9.4 and 9.5: M3 is not judged at every check point; the section test is capped at 40 heights (offset_surface.m:1324-1326). A set whose report has M3 = false is returned without refinement or error. Measured on the grader's fillet deck at t = 0.0762: rep.ok = 0, cap_reached = 0, no error

Plan T2a and contract F1 order of rules (steps 1a and 1b): on a box whose top is three constant-z rectangles with a T-junction at (0, 0, 0.5), F1 hands fit_z_faces general = 1 for box_side1, box_side2 and box_side4, and general = 0 for top_a, top_b and top_c. That is the reverse of the contract outcome (tops merge into one flat region, walls stay exact). inner_vertex (outer_nurbs.m:1408-1410) checks only boundaries 2 and 4, although for a constant-z patch every boundary counts as a row

Plan T2a interface to T2b not met: no fan-face or vertex-sphere entries with offset_of (grep offset_of: no hits); general inner pieces are passed as whole outer patches (offset_surface.m:124-134); mirrors of a general primary are dropped (lines 112-116)
Brief and procedure require all tests to pass: the suite has 6 failures in tests/standin_kit (structural, see spec_issues)

required_fixes.issue: split_corner_heights indexes H(:, 3) when no entry has a surf, so every deck with no exact patch crashes. Octave error: 'H(_,3): out of bound 0' at line 1203. Reproduced on capped_cylinder.ms2 with its axis tilted to run from (0.3, 0, -1) to T (a T2b tilted_revolution-type deck) and on a decimal fillet deck. The general path is never reached, before or after J1
required_fixes.fix: Start H as zeros(0, 3) and skip the corner-height splits when there are no exact entries
required_fixes.verify: Add a test: outer_nurbs on the tilted-axis deck with cache and opts.t_min reaches mwecmass.solid.fit_z_faces (on T2a's branch: an undefined-function error naming fit_z_faces, not Octave:index-out-of-bounds)

required_fixes.issue: On an exact deck with a smooth fold, the inner set fails M3. Deck: PolyCurve2 of Line (0,0,-3)-(1.4375,0,-3), Arc about (1.4375,0,-2.9375) to (1.5,0,-2.9375), Line to (1.5,0,1), Line to (0,0,1), revolved 0-90 deg with Symmetry x y; t = 0.0762, t_min = 0.0254, d = 0.076327 > fillet radius 0.0625. The fold is trimmed (dense t_local = d), but rep.ok = 0. Bottom piece: 'row heights not monotone' (z control values -2.923673, -2.923673, -2.9236730000000009, -2.923673). Side piece: 'boundary 2 has no neighbour' (its top row z 0.92367300000000019 against the top piece's 0.92367299999999997). Causes: (a) segments are marked straight only when sg.degree == 1, so the Lines of a PolyCurve2 elevated to degree 2 are fitted with cubics and the trim snapping at 436-456 is skipped; (b) fit_once copies a coordinate whose node values are all equal and so overrides fix0/fix1, and the two neighbours of a trim point end at different values
required_fixes.fix: Detect straight segments from the control points (bitwise collinear in (r, z); constant r or constant z as a special case), translate them exactly and snap their trim crossings. Make the shared trim point (fix0/fix1) take precedence over the all-equal shortcut so that both neighbours carry it bitwise
required_fixes.verify: On that deck at t = 0.0762: rep.ok = 1; the first-column control points of quarter 1 lie bitwise on the polyline (0,-3+d), (1.5-d,-3+d), (1.5-d,1-d), (0,1-d); every non-pole boundary is paired; dense t_local = d. At t = 0.0254 (no fold) the set still passes (grader measured 0.0254071..0.0256257)

required_fixes.issue: A set whose final report fails M3 (no cap reached) is returned silently. M3 failures are never refined, and FitNotConverged is raised only when the cap is reached
required_fixes.fix: When rep.ok is false on an adaptive (non-knots_from) fit, refine or raise mwecmass:solid:FitNotConverged listing the failing patches and M3_reason (AGENTS 9.5: never silently)
required_fixes.verify: Before fix 2 the fillet deck at t = 0.0762 raises the error; after fix 2 it returns ok

required_fixes.issue: The arc end test abs(norm(ve) - r) > 16*eps(r) scales with the radius, but the rounding comes from coordinate differences of magnitude max|S|,|Cn|,|E|. The decimal fillet Arc F1(1.45,0,-3), CF(1.45,0,-2.95), F2(1.5,0,-2.95) gives |ve| - r = 2.22e-16 > 1.11e-16, so it is not converted and the patch goes to the general path. C1 passes only with a factor of 2.7 to spare (8.3e-17 against 2.2e-16)
required_fixes.fix: Base the bound on the rounding of the coordinate subtraction (ulp of max(abs([S Cn E]))) with the derivation written in the comment, or submit the rule for owner approval (rule 5)
required_fixes.verify: The decimal fillet deck converts on the exact path (all 4 entries exact, rev_z); C1 is unchanged (test_outer_nurbs_c1 passes)

required_fixes.issue: Contract F1 rule order is not implemented: step 1a (constant-z patches with a vertex inside any boundary, or a corner inside another patch's row, join a flat region with every constant-z patch touching it at that height) must come before step 1b (count vertices, dropping seam end points between merged patches). Measured with a recording fit_z_faces stub on the top T-junction deck: walls box_side1/2/4 general = 1, tops top_a/b/c general = 0. inner_vertex returns false for boundaries 1 and 3 of constant-z patches
required_fixes.fix: Apply step 1a before vertex counting; treat every boundary of a constant-z patch as a row in inner_vertex; drop merged-region seam ends in step 1b. If the orchestrator assigns 1a/1b to fit_z_faces instead, F1 must not send lateral patches to the general path before those steps
required_fixes.verify: Test with a test-only recording stub of fit_z_faces on that deck (box x in [-1,1], y in [-0.75,0.75], z in [-2.5,0.5]; top as [-1,0]x[-0.75,0.75], [0,1]x[-0.75,0], [0,1]x[0,0.75]): general mask true for the three tops, false for the walls and the bottom

required_fixes.issue: Plan T2a interface to T2b: F2 must find the concave-crease fan faces that keep no structure and the vertex sphere faces, and hand them to fit_z_faces as entries with surf empty and offset_of (crease curve plus the outer entries on both sides; vertex point plus the outer entries around it). Instead, whole outer patches are passed as stubs (only the first piece, G(1)). Mirrors of a general primary are dropped: lines 112-116 mark a mirror general only when its primary is not. planar_inner sends every planar face with a concave neighbour to the general path although its trims are parameter lines. The implementer lists this as open issue 1
required_fixes.fix: Implement the hand-off as the plan specifies (every general piece including mirrors, fan entries per concave crease, sphere entries per vertex whose cone of normals spans a solid angle, with offset_of), or obtain an orchestrator decision moving this to T2b and amending the plan
required_fixes.verify: Test with a test-only recording stub of fit_z_faces on a planar deck with a concave crease and a concave vertex (written by the test, like the plan's riser foot or cross_column column foot). Assert one entry per concave crease with offset_of.crease, one per vertex with offset_of.vertex and its point, and mirrors present

required_fixes.issue: Rounding bounds that decide topology (crease or smooth, planarity, corner identity, vertex-on-row, curve coincidence) are set at 16, 64 and 256 ulp without derivation. Rule 5 and contract section 8 forbid underived merging bounds. On every tested deck the bitwise tests suffice: the C1 arc-to-curve1 leg cross product is exactly 0, and the split_wall_box cut-row ends equal M2 and M3 bitwise
required_fixes.fix: For each predicate, either write a derivation from the operation count in the comment (as contract S1 does for 4*2^-52), use the bitwise test, or list it for owner approval in the report
required_fixes.verify: Each bound carries a derivation or is gone; all solid tests still pass

required_fixes.issue: M3 sections are subsampled to 40 heights, so M3 is not judged at every check-point height (AGENTS 9.4). The test's own check uses 79 heights
required_fixes.fix: Judge the M3 section test at every check-point height; or, if a limit is wanted, make it an option reported in S2r and get it approved
required_fixes.verify: S2r reports the number of M3 heights equal to the number of distinct check heights; the C1 tests still pass

required_fixes.issue: The cache key identifies opts.knots_from only by its t and patch count. Two knot sets with the same t (an adaptive set, and a refit set whose .t is the same) collide and return a wrong cached refit
required_fixes.fix: Key knots_from by a fingerprint of its knot vectors (bitwise), as is done for geo
required_fixes.verify: Two knots_from sets with equal t and count but different knots give different results; the identity test still passes

required_fixes.issue: The header says it fits 'the offset boundary curve of a ruled piece'; no caller does (ruled inner faces copy the rev_z neighbour's boundary, offset_surface.m:1067-1124). Stale comment

AGENTS 5 item 9.1 requires initial nodes dense where the curvature is high or the void is narrow. Only the tangent-turn rule (pi/4) is implemented. Measured on C1 at t = 0.0254: 5 passes, with 40 knots inserted and then removed. Not listed as deferred
required_fixes.fix: Add the narrow-void criterion to the initial knots, or list it as deferred with a reason in the report
required_fixes.verify: C1 t = 0.0254 pass count printed before and after, or the deferral is stated in the report

spec_issues: The 6 tests in tests/standin_kit (test_sk_body, _closed_form, _not_analytic, _offset_slice, _outer_nurbs, _realised) pass 6/6 at e7e9114 and fail on any branch whose src holds the real F1-F4. They test the stand-ins, and the real functions win the path by design (contract section 3). The ownership map (SK -> SK2 -> J1) forbids T2a to edit them, so 'all tests pass' cannot hold for T2a, T2b or T3 before J1. The orchestrator must decide: exclude standin_kit from these tasks' gate, or make the SK tests force the stand-ins.

Plan T2a acceptance 'fold trimming tested ... C1 at t >= 0.100 m' contradicts contract section 8: C1 d_close = 0.1 equals the smallest convex radius 0.100 m, so F2 must raise VoidClosed at every d >= 0.1, and a C1 fold cannot be built. Fold trimming is testable only on other decks (cylinder rims, stepped_spar, a fillet deck).

Contract F1 evaluates AbsBead on the converted curve, which gives the C1 keel z = -3.2500000000000004 (rational evaluation with weights 1). Contract section 3 states surface1 z_range [1.1 -3.25], and MS2Parser (BeadBottom, eval_surface) and config.strip_edges give exactly -3.25. With heights compared bitwise (F1, F5), the lowest module edge -3.25 lies strictly inside the keel patch's z range, so F5 would cut a 4.4e-16 m sliver at the keel pole. A rule is needed: bead z from the parser, or consumers use geo.z_range.

Contract F2 says 'Nodes from MS2Parser + T1 surface_normals'. T2a offsets the exact F1 NURBS instead, which matches section 8's 'judged between the faces as written'; the measured agreement is 3.78e-4 m <= eps_fit/2 = 3.81e-4. The contract text should state which applies on the exact path.

The fit_z_faces interface does not say what an inner general-piece entry contains (which outer region or trim curves define the piece; whether mirrors are passed or generated by fit_z_faces). It also says fit_z_faces moves 'further entries to the general path by the Cuts and flat-region rules', but F1 is also told to apply rules 1a/1b first. The split of steps 1a/1b between F1 (T2a) and fit_z_faces (T2b) needs one owner.

The contract sanctions only T1's 16-ulp bound (rev_z axis). It gives no rule for the other rounding predicates the exact path needs: smooth or crease joint, planarity, a new row end being at a corner (F1 column corners 'identified with the corners'), and boundary coincidence (tie-break 'shared end to end'). Without a stated rule, every implementer must invent one (rule 5).
